Brief received

Thank you.

Your brief is with us, and a confirmation is on its way to your inbox. It has been passed to My Event Match so relevant event styling and hire professionals can review it.

  1. 01We review the briefYour location, date, elements and design direction are used to identify relevant professionals.
  2. 02Professionals respondYou'll hear back with approach, availability and pricing — usually within one to two business days.
  3. 03You compare and chooseReview the responses and decide what feels right. There is no obligation to book.
